object.attr: stakeholder: draw.io can't edit a plain SVG, and a save from draw.io would replace the picture. MELLON-STORE-SRS-132 says which figures are draw.io figures; the test case covers a plain SVG holding the text mxfile and a draw.io figure (CF-E28).
object.description: While the selected object's figure isn't a draw.io figure, the Document Editor shall disable Edit in draw.io.
